solutions.title: DFS equality
solutions.description:
**Approach:** Both null → true; one null or vals differ → false; else recurse left and right.

**Why preferred:** Clean base cases; easy to adapt to BFS.

solutions.title: Recursive structural equality
solutions.description:
**Approach:** Null/null true; if values equal, recurse both children; else false.

**vs recommended:** Matches the intended solution. Be careful with `p?.val === q?.val` when one side is null and the other isn’t (optional chaining can hide a mismatch — prefer explicit null checks).
